fake.h: Vending machine in {} drops 1,267 free chocolate bars after a moth lands on the service switch
fake.tell: A moth is far too light to trip a switch, and the service switch sits inside the locked machine.

fake.h: Postman in {} delivers 1,486 letters to one house after a child's drawing covers a street sign
fake.tell: Post is sorted by postcode and address, not by reading street signs.

fake.h: Stray llama spends 6 nights in a hotel lobby in {} before staff realise it is not a decoration
fake.tell: A live llama eats, moves and smells; staff would notice within minutes.

fake.h: Fishing trawler off {} nets a sunken piano that still plays 3 notes in tune
fake.tell: Seawater ruins a piano's strings and felts; nothing would still be in tune.

fake.h: Hiker in {} reports a UFO that turns out to be his own drone, still filming him 214 metres up
fake.tell: Drones run out of battery in about half an hour, so his own drone couldn't still be hovering over him.

fake.h: Hotel in {} bills a guest for 37 minibar items he drank while away on a 9-day cruise
fake.tell: He couldn't drink from the minibar while he was away at sea.

fake.tell: Anthems are played once before kick-off; a jammed scoreboard has nothing to do with them.

fake.tell: A bin lorry's lift arms are built for wheelie bins; they can't lift a car.

fake.tell: Funiculars are emptied at the terminus on every run.
